title: VOID PVP — cosmetics catalog
description: The shape of `schema/cosmetics.json`, the single source of the cosmetics catalog. Every launch cosmetic's metadata (id, kind, name, rarity, price, tintability, store preview) lives there and nowhere else: `scripts/gen-cosmetics.mjs` generates the Java catalog the mod reads (`mod/.../cosmetic/CosmeticCatalog.java`), the TypeScript module the launcher and the in-game UI import (`packages/protocol/src/generated/cosmetics.ts`), and the backend seeds Supabase from the same file. The *assets* (model, textures, animation) are not catalog data: they are bundled in the mod jar under `assets/void/cosmetics/<id>/`, compiled from `mod/src/main/cosmetics-src/<id>/` by the same script, so rendering never waits on the network. The backend only ever says who owns and wears what.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema.

version.description: Catalog version. Bumped by hand when an item is added, removed or changes kind; ids never change meaning once shipped, because ownership rows in the backend are keyed by them.

items.description: Every cosmetic, in store order within each kind.

item_id.title: Cosmetic id
item_id.description: Kebab-case, globally unique, never reused. The backend's ownership rows, the equipped set and the asset folder `assets/void/cosmetics/<id>/` are all keyed by it.

slot.title: Slot
slot.description: Where a worn cosmetic goes; one item per slot. `back` holds wings and other back items, `head` hats, `face` masks, `halo` floats above the head and may coexist with a hat, `trail` is particles while moving, `badge` the icon beside the nametag.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: A slot name, or `emote`. Emotes are not worn: a player keeps up to eight on their wheel.

rarity.title: Rarity
rarity.description: Display tier. `exclusive` is for granted items that cannot be bought (the founder badge).

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: `paid`: sold for `price_cents` through checkout. `free`: every account owns it (`price_cents` must be 0). `grant`: owned only when granted by the backend (founders, events); never listed for sale.

preview.title: Store preview
preview.description: How the launcher's Store draws the item's card art (`apps/desktop/src/features/art.tsx`). Not the in-game look, which is the bundled asset. `style` picks the drawing; `pattern`, `hue` and `rows` parameterise it.

style.description: Which drawing: the item's kind, mostly.

pattern.description: Variant of the drawing, e.g. a cape pattern or a trail motion.

rows.description: Emotes only: the pose glyph as rows of `#` and `.`.

blurb.description: One line for the item sheet, lower-case start, ends with a full stop: it follows `<Kind> · `.

price_cents.description: Price in US cents. 0 for `free` and `grant` items.

tintable.description: Whether the equipped set's `tints` may recolour it. The tint multiplies the texture's grey-scale tint mask.

default_tint.description: The colour a tintable item wears with no tint set.

is_new.description: Flags the item as new in the Store.

test.description: A style-test item (design comparison, see pvp/design/cosmetics-style-test/): bundled in the mod jar so the dev showcase can draw it, and nothing else. It is left out of the TypeScript catalog (launcher Store, in-game wardrobe), out of the Supabase seed, and out of the mod's catalog enumeration; it must be `grant`, cost 0 and have an id starting `style-`.

loop.description: Emotes only: holds and repeats until cancelled by moving or attacking (e.g. sit) rather than playing once.

items.name: Origin cape
items.blurb: two halves of grey. Every account has one.
